governance_rules.SAUCE001: Mother sauces and direct classical derivatives retain distinct pairing profiles.
governance_rules.SAUCE002: Cross-domain composition references use canonical IDs — pairing does not duplicate ingredient metadata.
governance_rules.SAUCE_PAIR001: Pair by culinary function — acidity, fat, fermentation, emulsification, umami, richness — not raw ingredient identity.
governance_rules.WINE001: Wine relationships may never modify or imply structural taxonomy — pairing layer is independent.
governance_rules.WINE002: Pairings reference canonical wine ontology IDs (wine style catalog) only.
governance_rules.WINE003: Pairings are directional from food entity to wine entity.
governance_rules.WINE004: Multiple wines permitted per food entity with independent confidence and pairing method.
governance_rules.WINE005: No transitive inference — food-wine edges do not imply food-food relationships.
